name: Monmouth County, NJ
findings: Monmouth County has 2,411 nonprofit organizations. 1,078 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 842 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Monmouth County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 18 housing organizations here list public events, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 169 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
